label: Gemini CLI
notes: Gemini CLI reads .gemini/skills/ or .agents/skills/ (and ~/.gemini/skills/ or ~/.agents/skills/). Docs read from google-gemini/gemini-cli docs/cli/skills.md.
caveats: Gemini CLI skips project skills in folders it does not trust ("Skipping project agents due to untrusted folder"). Trust the project folder, or install with --scope user. Observed with gemini 0.64.0 on 2026-10-15.
